title: Red Hat Security Advisory: curl security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-92392) affecting the curl utility and libcurl library in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 has been addressed. The flaw is a Use-After-Free issue related to HTTP/2 upload functionality. Red Hat has released an important security update fixing this vulnerability in curl packages for multiple architectures. Users of affected Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 versions are advised to apply the update as detailed in the Red Hat advisory.
